summary: Round 30, morning execution check, 29 Sep ~01:20 UTC (04:20 MSK), local files only, 0 Kaggle calls. Branch A holds: exp89r went at 00:05:28Z, so the KEY is exp89r. The two morning slots are decided by displays alone. A-M1 = exp89l iff exp89p displays >= 0.959 (decide at its terminal header, latest 08:40Z; submit by 08:45Z). A 0.958 read is now '0' by construction, because our row is already 0.959, so '0u' is impossible (R30M-1). A-M2 = UNUSED unless exp89r displays >= 0.960 with L_hi <= 10.75 h. Given that, it is exp89s if exp89r - exp89p >= 0.003, UNUSED if <= -0.001, else exp89q (decide at exp89r's terminal header, latest 11:00Z; submit by 11:30Z). One cell conflicts between two logged texts: exp89p = 0.958 with exp89r = 0.960. The 21:11Z precedence gives exp89q (carries SEC), while the 23:34Z freeze (9) says SEC '0' removes SEC. Resolve it pre-score now; recommended UNUSED (R30M-2). New fact: LB SubmissionCount and LastSubmissionDate count only scored submissions, so S1_P must show count 54 and date 2026-09-29 00:46:36 (R30M-4). UP tests no longer change any morning slot; they feed only the 0.959 V_pub tie. Exact nb_try commands, -m texts and guards are in R30M-5. Stale timer texts: the 07:23Z text must not rebuild exp89l, and 08:30Z is not the A-M1 cutoff (R30M-6). No new lever reaches R8; both slots staying UNUSED is the most likely and honest outcome (R30M-7).

findings.what: P's '0u' can no longer happen, so A-M1 depends on exp89p's display alone. MORNING TABLE v1.1 (14:12Z) and R29-A6 were written while our LB row was 0.958. Since probe 51 our row is exp87a at 0.959. An exp89p that displays 0.958 is unrounded < 0.9585 <= exp87a, so it cannot move our row: its UP test gives k = 0 by construction (BLIND), and P = '0'. Result: A-M1 = exp89l if and only if exp89p is COMPLETE, has no ERROR and displays >= 0.959; any 0.958 read makes A-M1 UNUSED. The P UP test (S0 = _lb/S1_51, count 53 -> 54) still matters, but only for the finals card: at an equal 0.959 display, k >= 1 means exp89p > exp87a unrounded. V_pub then becomes exp89p (non-CI; SEC is allowed as V_pub by Q3). k = 0 leaves exp87a first by the logged tie order (last attributable UP at that display).

findings.what: One cell has two conflicting logged texts: exp89p = 0.958 (P '0') and exp89r = 0.960 (Rr '+'). There dd = (0.960 - 0.958) - (0.959 - 0.958) = +0.001, so DIS = '?'. The 21:11Z A-M2 PRECEDENCE says 'Rr + with DIS ? -> exp89q'. But exp89q carries SEC, and the 23:34Z W4 FREEZE item (9) says 'First LB read of SEC = exp89p vs exp85a; 0 or - removes SEC from every morning file'. No other cell conflicts. With d_R >= 0.960 and d_P <= 0.957, d_R - d_P >= 0.003, which is DIS '+' -> exp89s (SEC-free). With d_R = 0.961, the '?' cells have d_P >= 0.959, so P is '+'. P '?' (ERROR or late) is not covered by (9); by the letter it goes to exp89q.

findings.what: MORNING DECISION TABLE (branch A; KEY = exp89r was submitted; d_P and d_R are 3-decimal displays; nothing depends on exp75). A-M1 (CI). Decide at the first poll header where 56657612 (exp89p) is terminal, latest the 08:40Z header; submit by 08:45Z. (i) d_P >= 0.959, COMPLETE, no ERROR -> exp89l. (ii) d_P = 0.958 -> '0' (BLIND) -> UNUSED. (iii) d_P <= 0.957 -> UNUSED. (iv) ERROR, or not terminal at the 08:40Z header -> UNUSED. At any header <= 08:40Z, L <= 7.9 h is below the 8.0 h non-CI insertion gate, so no gap clause can trigger. A-M2 (non-CI). Decide at the first header where 56656147 (exp89r) is terminal, latest the 11:00Z header; submit by 11:30Z. The step is Rr: '+' needs d_R >= 0.960, COMPLETE, no ERROR, and first-COMPLETE header + 210 s x failed attempts <= 10:50:28Z (10.75 h). 10:17:28Z < L_hi-time <= 10:50:28Z keeps '+' flagged UNPROVEN-ins as a normal read. Otherwise (d_R <= 0.959 incl. Rr '0u', ERROR, late, or L_hi > 10.75 h) -> UNUSED. Given Rr '+': d_R - d_P >= 0.003 (DIS '+') -> exp89s. d_R - d_P <= -0.001 (DIS '-', which implies d_P >= 0.961) -> UNUSED. d_R - d_P in {0, 0.001, 0.002}, or P '?' (DIS '?') -> exp89q, except the cell (0.958, 0.960) -> see R30M-2. Grid at d_R = 0.960: d_P <= 0.957 exp89s; 0.958 CONFLICT; 0.959 exp89q; 0.960 exp89q; >= 0.961 UNUSED. Grid at d_R = 0.961: d_P <= 0.958 exp89s; 0.959-0.961 exp89q; >= 0.962 UNUSED. Branch-B rows (B-M1 exp89s, exp89u) are moot: exp89r went at 00:05:28Z rc 0. An exp89r hidden-run ERROR is Rr '?', not a switch to branch B. exp75 only feeds EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 on the card. V_pub is exp87a (CI), so rule (b) applies (pair B only at >= 0.955 clean), or rule (a) if a non-CI exp89p becomes V_pub. Its CI-RAN needs L_hi > 8.04 h (header after ~08:08Z); clean needs L_hi <= 10.2 h (<= 10:17:34Z). Masking: exp75 at ~0.954 is below our row (>= 0.959), so it cannot mask exp89r's UP test even in a +2 count window (R26-A4 (b)).

M55L="probe 55: exp89l = exp70g (cap 6) + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 + n2a SEC 7029fe69 + coordinject ALPHA 0.5 MAX_UM 3.0 (K + SEC + CI; morning A-M1)"; M56S="probe 56: exp89s = exp70g (cap 6) + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 + ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25 (K + DIS, non-CI; morning A-M2)"; M56Q="probe 56: exp89q = exp70g (cap 6) + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 + n2a SEC 7029fe69 + ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25 (non-CI twin of the RISK STACK; morning A-M2)". findings.what: Honest answer on new levers: nothing reaches R8. R8 closed new mechanisms on 27 Sep 12:00Z, and after 29 Sep 02:00Z only an emergency repeat is allowed. The whitelist {K, SEC n2a, DIS 2.25, CI} is used up by the night files, exp89l, exp89s and exp89q (I-320, R28P-11, R29F-9). Checked and not proposed: (1) using an UNUSED morning slot for exp89s or exp89q anyway (for example as a SEC-free non-CI V_pub candidate for the Q3 P1 line) is the winners-only violation logged at 14:12Z/21:11Z, and a public read with no finals value unless it reads >= 0.960; (2) re-submitting exp85a or exp87a to 'refresh' the tie order is pointless, because ties go to the earlier submit and finals are picked from existing refs; (3) any new knob value (READMIT 0.92, TAU 0.7, DIS 1.75, IDW < 0.4) is on the exclusion list of v1.1 (0)(i) and R26-A4 (e). The only open path stays the standing override: a disclosed knob or a public notebook >= 0.960 (E10; after 02:00Z it needs the user's yes, dummy first). The slots must stay free for that. UNUSED is not a loss: the expected gain of a public read that cannot become a final is ~0 on private.

findings.what: Ambiguities checked and resolved from the text, so no action is needed. (a) Rr '0u' does not trigger A-M2: only '+' does, per v1.1 (2) and the 21:11Z precedence. This matches R25-A1 (4): '0u counts as + for BEST_CI only'. (b) GAP RULE v2 (3) (51 UNPROVEN-ins -> dd/Rr '?') does not apply: 51 had L_hi 9.48 h with no flag. (c) exp89p's 8.0 h insertion gate cannot fire on a read that is in time for A-M1: the 08:40Z header gives L <= 7.9 h. (d) The 40-min spacing binds only non-CI pairs: M2 vs exp89p (00:46Z) is fine; M1 is CI. (e) At most 5 submits on 29 Sep: 3 are used, 2 remain, for M1 and M2. (f) The KEY is branch A even if exp89r later ERRORs on the hidden run (KEY = the stack actually submitted). (g) The 0.959 V_pub tie: a k = 0 exp89p leaves exp87a first ('last attributable UP at that display'); only k >= 1 moves V_pub to exp89p.
